passages.note: Lists HB 1296's author, co-authors, and Senate sponsors; Pierce does not appear in any of these roles.
Pierce is listed among the Nay votes on adoption of the conference committee report on HB 1296, a bill that repealed Indiana's handgun carry license requirement.

passages.provision_quote: A person may carry a handgun without being licensed under this chapter to carry a handgun if:
passages.note: The enrolled act's operative text removes the license requirement to carry a handgun, the provision Pierce voted against.

rows.reasoning: Pierce voted Nay on HB 1296 (2022), whose operative provision states 'A person may carry a handgun without being licensed under this chapter to carry a handgun if:', matching the rung text 'Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit.' His No vote shows only that he opposed this repeal, not which of the remaining rungs he holds, so the evidence is direction-only.
needs_source: Pierce's own statement, or a separate vote/sponsorship, specifying which gun regulations (e.g. universal background checks, an assault-style weapons ban, or no new restrictions) he supports, to distinguish among rungs 1-4.
